class.name: RenderingNativeSurfaceApple
class.brief_description: Rendering surface backed by an Apple layer.
class.description: Wraps an Apple rendering layer for LibGodot embedding. The wrapper retains its layer while alive. Native UI changes must follow Apple main-thread requirements.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a wrapper for the native layer pointer encoded in [param layer]. A zero pointer requests a new layer.

method.name: get_layer
method.description: Returns the native layer pointer encoded as an integer.
